description: Save one of the user's sessions as a TEMPLATE in their Metodic library, so a recurring meeting or workshop (a weekly Level 10, a monthly retro, a standard onboarding) can be set up again in one step with use_template. Free. The free plan holds one template; paid plans and AppSumo unlimited.

description.description: One or two sentences: when to use this template.

session_id.description: The Metodic session (toolkit) id to keep as a template.

share_with_team.description: Also show it to the user's team. Default false.

name: save_template
title: Save as template
